title: character
description: A MetaHuman character (WP3): made from a preset, a copy or blank; shaped (body, face), skinned, eyes, eyelashes, teeth, makeup, grooms with colours, outfit; Epic's cloud rig and textures; built into a Blueprint; optionally garments of your own on a placed actor. Converged by the mh.* ops (mh.add, mh.body, mh.face, mh.skin, mh.eyes, mh.eyelashes, mh.teeth, mh.makeup, mh.groom, mh.add_item, mh.rig, mh.textures, mh.build, mh.dress); in the editor in one job by mh.apply. Guide: docs/unreal/metahuman.md.

settings.description: engine settings fields as nested JSON (CamelCase or snake_case names; enums by name, e.g. LongCurl; colours [r, g, b] linear 0..1). mh.settings_fields lists them with their values.

eye.description: FMetaHumanCharacterEyeProperties: iris {iris_pattern Iris001..Iris009, primary_color_u/v 0..1, secondary_color_u/v, color_blend, limbal_ring_size}, pupil {dilation, feather}, cornea {size}, sclera {tint, vascularity_intensity}

item.description: a wardrobe item: asset name (WI_Hair_L_Straight) or path (mh.wardrobe lists them)

params.description: the item's instance parameters by name (mh.item_params lists them): Roughness, Whiteness, Lightness, DyeColor [r,g,b], bUseOmbre, OmbreU, ... for grooms; colours for garments

name.description: the character's name: the Blueprint is BP_<name> unless build.name says otherwise

from.description: where a missing character starts (ignored once it exists)

source.description: another character asset to copy (a variant)

body.description: the parametric body. Short form: {constraint: value} (cm; Fat, Muscularity, Masculine/Feminine unitless; null frees one). Long form: {measurements: {...}, from_character: <asset>, reset: bool}. mh.body_constraints lists names and ranges.

from_character.description: copy every active constraint of another character first

face.description: the face (changing it on a rigged character removes the rig: the plan re-rigs)

blend.description: {preset name or character path: weight}: a weighted mix of their face model coefficients (experimental)

coefficients.description: the face model's coefficients (mh.describe full=true / mh.export)

landmarks.description: {landmark index: [dx, dy, dz] cm} moves, applied once (mh.face_landmarks lists them)

skin.description: skin: u, v (tone 0..1), roughness (0.85..1.15), texture_resolution (2k|4k|8k for the cloud textures), and any FMetaHumanCharacterSkinSettings field (freckles {density, strength, saturation, tone_shift, mask None|Type1..3}, accents {scalp, forehead, nose, under_eye, cheeks, lips, chin, ears: {redness, saturation, lightness}}, skin {face_texture_index, body_texture_index, palm_lightness, fingernail_tint_color, ...}) directly or under settings. A skin change discards the cloud textures (the plan fetches them again).

eyes.description: eye settings for both eyes; left/right go over both

eyelashes.description: type None|ShortSparse|ShortFine|ShortThin|LongSlightCurl|LongCurl|LongThickCurl, melanin, redness, lightness, salt_and_pepper, roughness 0..1, dye_color, enable_grooms

teeth.description: tooth_length, tooth_spacing, upper_shift, lower_shift, overbite, overjet (-1..1); worn_down, polycanine, receding_gums, narrowness, variation, plaque_amount (0..1); teeth_color, gum_color, plaque_color

makeup.description: foundation {apply_foundation, color, intensity, concealer}, eyes {type None|ThinLiner|SoftSmokey|FullThinLiner|CatEye|PandaSmudge|DramaticSmudge|DoubleMod|ClassicBar, primary_color, opacity}, blush {type None|Angled|Apple|LowSweep|HighCurve, color, intensity}, lips {type None|Natural|Hollywood|Cupid, color, opacity}

grooms.description: per groom slot: an item with colour/params, or none

outfit.description: the Creator outfit (Outfits slot), or none

rig.description: Epic's cloud auto-rig: full = joints + blend shapes (facial animation), joints, or none (no cloud, no build). Needs the Epic sign-in.

textures.description: fetch the cloud high-resolution textures (default: when rigged; the build needs them)

name.description: BP_<name> and the unpack folder (default the spec's name)

build_path.description: where the built assets go (default <character folder>/Unpacked/<name>)

build.description: assemble into a Blueprint (default when rigged), or false

dress.description: garments of your own on the placed actor of this character (place BP_<name> first)

mesh.description: skeletal mesh on the MetaHuman skeleton, in cm (mh.import_garment)
